narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The diagonal of a slanted parallelogram is a line of symmetry, because it cuts two equal halves.
<bookmark mark='fold'/>Fold the parallelogram along that diagonal, and look closely. The two corners do not land on each other.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Halves of the same size are not enough. The halves must match when folded.
